questions.question: On a sum, simple interest at the annual rate of 12 percent for 6 years is Rs. 28800. What will be the compound interest on the same sum at the annual rate of 20 percent (compounding annually) for 2 years?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Simple Interest** percentage = 12% × 6 = 72%

Value of 72% = Rs. 28800 ⇒ 1% = 400

Effective **Compound Interest** rate for 2 years at 20% = 20 + 20 + (20 × 20)/100 = 44%

Required Compound Interest = 44 × 400 = Rs. 17600

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 17600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Rs. 28800, Rate (R₁) = 12%, Time (T₁) = 6 years

Compound Interest Rate (R₂) = 20%, Time (T₂) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

CI = P[(1 + R/100)ⁿ − 1]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7722f3e97135dd1f769a070c9ec86b45e23df1baba29c6795691d7ce160cc552.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 28800 = (P × 12 × 6) ÷ 100

⇒ 28800 = (P × 72) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (28800 × 100) ÷ 72

⇒ P = 400 × 100 = Rs. 40000

Now, calculating CI for 2 years at 20%:

⇒ CI = 40000[(1 + 20/100)² − 1]

⇒ CI = 40000[(1.2)² − 1]

⇒ CI = 40000[1.44 − 1]

⇒ CI = 40000 × 0.44

⇒ CI = Rs. 17600

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 17600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 2 years, the effective rate can be calculated using the formula: R + R + (R² ÷ 100)%.

Difference between CI and SI

The difference between CI and SI for 2 years is P(R ÷ 100)². For 3 years, it is P(R ÷ 100)² × [(300 + R) ÷ 100].

Rule of 72

To find the approximate time required to double your money at a given interest rate, divide 72 by the annual interest rate (72 ÷ Rate).</p

questions.question: If we sum the gross value added of all the firms of the economy in a year, we get a measure of the value of aggregate amount of goods and services produced by the economy in a year. Such an estimate is called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gross domestic product.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** is a measure of the **total value of all goods and services** produced within a country's borders in a **specific period, usually a year.**
 
• It is calculated by** summing up** the value of all** final goods and services **produced in the economy, including **consumption, investment, government spending, and net exports.**
 
• GDP is an important indicator of the** health of an economy**, as it reflects the **level of economic activity.**
 
• **GDP** can be used to compare the performance of **different countries or regions.**

• **Net Value Added (NVA)** is the value of output produced by a firm after** deducting the cost of intermediate inputs**, such as** raw materials and energy.**
